text: Brent closed at 92.14 USD/bbl on 11 November, up 2.2% from 90.16 USD/bbl the previous day, and has gained 0.3% over the past week. On 1 November, Egypt extended the bid deadline for the 14-block EGAS and EGPC rounds to 14 December 2026. Separately, Genel Energy agreed on 28 September to buy Capricorn Energy's Western Desert interests for USD 436 mn.
